'''Fußballsportverein Frankfurt 1899 e.V.''', commonly known as simply '''FSV Frankfurt''' and known as simply '''Frankfurt''', is a [[Football in Germany|German association football club]] based in the [[Bornheim (Frankfurt)|Bornheim district]] of [[Frankfurt am Main]], Hessen and founded in 1899. FSV Frankfurt formerly fielded a rather successful women's team, which was disbanded in 2006."}}
